reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on vague, unvalidated correlations (rule-of-mixtures, VEC) to predict complex fracture behavior in a hierarchical heterostructure, ignoring the critical role of local stress concentrations and crack path tortuosity that simple descriptors cannot capture.
reasons.testability: The falsification test is clearly defined with specific quantitative thresholds (20% accuracy, 50% time reduction) and independent experimental measurements, making the hypothesis decisively testable.
reasons.usefulness: The proposed framework is too generic and lacks a concrete, novel mechanism linking the specific hierarchical heterostructure to properties, offering little actionable insight beyond a standard data-fitting exercise.
